quotes: the structure that fits the forces this system will actually face, chosen on purpose
pattern-selector.why: the forces were many parallel pull requests, a host (GitHub) that ignores merge drivers, append-only history that must stay tamper-evident, and consumers still on the single-file log. The chosen shape is no pattern: one file per record plus one shared reader; the rejected options (a custom merge driver, hand resolution, a post-merge bot) are in ADR-0108.
pattern-selector.what: replaced the shared append files with stamped entry folders and one reader module (entry-log.mjs) behind three gates, kept a legacy file path, and made the release fold the only writer of CHANGELOG.md.

quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work
architectural-decision-records.why: changing where every change records its review, receipt, coverage entry, and changelog note, and superseding ADR-0087, is a significant decision.
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR-0108 (MADR, accepted) with the measured conflict counts, the options, the consequences, and what it does not fix; check_adr.sh and strict claim-lint pass.

quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment.
bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: the behavior is specified as executable scenarios for the operator and agent audiences across happy, negative, error, and edge paths, and the skill's own storage rules changed (a folder coverage log, a derivable datastore).
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: added features/repo-process/one-file-per-change.feature (8 scenarios, 12 runs) driving real git merges, the real readers, and the real release script; added this change's coverage-log entry as a new file; 153 runs passed and check-bdd-executed passed on 128 scenarios.

quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug
comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the reader, the append-only rule, the runner, and the release fold are unit tested; the layout is integration tested with a real two-branch git merge and a failing control.
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: added test/entry-log.test.mjs, test/no-shared-append-files.test.mjs, test/changelog-release.test.mjs; rewrote test/all-tests-wired.test.mjs for the discovering runner, with a junction case and pass and fail controls.

quotes: test must FAIL when the check is replaced by a no-op
verifiable-quality-gates.why: the change rewires gates (append-only, entry names, the test runner), so each must fail when neutralized; 19 hand-run mutants each failed their tests, including the review's fail-open cases (a junction path, a skipped extension, a per-entry check).
verifiable-quality-gates.what: ran a mutation pass over entry-log.mjs, bdd-lib.mjs, check-bdd-coverage.mjs, run-tests.mjs, and changelog-release.mjs: 19 of 19 killed.

quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it
skeptical-audit.why: the root cause and the counts are backed by re-runnable observations (35/35/30 both-sides changes in 80 merges; PRs 198 and 201 CONFLICTING with merge=union committed), the migration is byte-for-byte checked, and the limits are named (same-line code conflicts, semantic breaks without a merge queue, one malformed legacy entry).
skeptical-audit.what: measured the conflict sources from git history, verified the split round-trip, tagged every ADR claim, and recorded what this does not fix.

quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.
judge-arch.why: a fresh-context review of the whole change ran against the four questions and is recorded as a new entry file.
judge-arch.what: dispatched the review to a fresh subagent; it found 8 issues (2 medium, 6 low), all fixed and re-proven, and the review entry was added.

quotes: Dark-launch: ship the code off, turn it on for internal users, then 1 percent
release-deployment-safety.why: the gates ship to consumers, so the change is expand-only for them: a legacy single-file log still reads by default, a present committed BDD datastore is still checked, and the new folder form is opt-in by creating the folder.
release-deployment-safety.what: kept defaultLogPath and coverageLogPath falling back to the legacy file, and kept the legacy --base <file> path; tests cover both forms.

quotes: Simplicity that meets the real requirement is a core principle, not a shortcut.
enterprise-architecture-standards.why: three gates each parsed the log on their own; they now share one reader, and the BDD skill keeps one justified copy because it installs on its own, with a parity test so the copies cannot drift.
enterprise-architecture-standards.what: added entry-log.mjs as the single owner of the review and receipt log format, and a test that the three stamped-name patterns stay one rule.

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal or regulated data; the moved records are review and receipt history, kept byte for byte and still append-only.

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: the coupling rule fired on migrated entry names containing session, and the real surface is a git subprocess fed a ref from a CLI flag or CI env. Threat: a ref like --output=<file> read as a git option would write a file (argument injection). Countermeasure: --end-of-options before the ref, an argument array with no shell, CI passes the ref through env, and any git failure fails closed.
owasp-secure-coding-bdd.what: added --end-of-options to the ls-tree and diff calls in entry-log.mjs and bdd-lib.mjs, and a @security test that an option-looking ref fails closed and writes no file.
quotes: A threat with no countermeasure is a vulnerability, not a decision.

sre-operational-readiness.why: no running service or endpoint; the append-only check went from one git process per entry to two in total (0.3 s here).

arch-encode.why: the caught mistake (a shared append file) is now pinned by test/no-shared-append-files.test.mjs rather than an arch-gate forbid rule, because it is about which files are tracked, not a code pattern.

universal-browser-device-support.why: no browser or device surface; these are Node scripts and CI config.

usability-ux-universal-design.why: no interactive surface; contributor docs were rewritten in plain steps.
